subject: Post-demo: Payment path & invoice format questions (PO / Marketplace / Net terms)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Payment path & invoice format questions (PO / Marketplace / Net terms)

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really enjoyed the conversation and the use-case you shared for patient intake form summarization. Per our call, a few quick items I promised to clarify so your procurement and billing teams can evaluate paths:

Key commercial paths we discussed:
- Card (self-serve) via Redwood hosted API
- Purchase Order (PO) with monthly invoicing (net 30 / net 45)
- Cloud marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) — single invoice through marketplace billing

Questions I wanted to confirm for your side so we can recommend the smoothest path:
1) Will Astra Health require a PO for initial pilot purchases, or are chargeable cards accepted for proofs-of-value?
2) If PO is required, who signs contracts (procurement vs legal)? Is a third-party marketplace purchase acceptable to procurement?
3) Billing details required on invoices: billing address, tax/VAT ID, purchase order number location, and any specific invoice reference fields (e.g., project codes).
4) Preferred net terms (Net 30 / Net 45) and whether legal prefers our standard MSA or needs a redline review.

I attached a blank PO template you mentioned and a sample Redwood invoice — this should speed validation with your AP team. Can you share a best contact in procurement (name + email) and ideally confirm whether marketplace procurement is on the table?

Next steps (proposed):
- Sophie to confirm procurement contact + PO requirement by end of week
- I’ll loop in our billing ops and legal if PO or custom invoice fields are required
- If marketplace is acceptable, I’ll send AWS Marketplace onboarding checklist and expected timelines

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min call with procurement if that helps.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0147

Attachments: Astra_PO_template.pdf (attachment stub), redwood_invoice_sample.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@astrahealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Andrew Park <andrew.park@astrahealth.com>, Astra Health Procurement <procurement@astrahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Payment path & invoice format questions (PO / Marketplace / Net terms)

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the samples. Quick answers from my side:

1) For pilots under $25k, we can generally use a corporate card via cost-center approval. Anything above that typically needs a PO. This pilot will likely be under that threshold but final decision depends on procurement.
2) Procurement handles PO issuance but legal signs the master agreement. Marketplace purchases are acceptable in principle, but procurement needs to confirm marketplace billing reconciliation with our finance team.
3) Required invoice fields for our AP team:
   - Full billing address (we use our corporate HQ)
   - Tax ID (EIN)
   - PO number (if applicable) in the invoice header and the invoice line items
   - Project code: Project-AST21 (please include as an invoice reference)
4) Preferred net terms: Net 30 for PO-based invoices. Card transactions are immediate.

Contact: Andrew Park (andrew.park@astrahealth.com) is the procurement representative — I’ve cc’d him here. He’ll be the person who confirms marketplace feasibility and PO flow.

I’ve attached the PO template you sent back with a few notes in the header line to indicate where we want the PO number to appear.

— Sophie
Sophie Chen
Head of Product, Integrations | Astra Health
sophie.chen@astrahealth.com

Attachments: Astra_PO_template.pdf (annotated)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Andrew Park <andrew.park@astrahealth.com>, Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: Payment path & invoice format questions (PO / Marketplace / Net terms)

Andrew —

Great to meet you (virtually). Per Sophie’s note, thanks for taking a look at marketplace/PO feasibility. A couple of operational clarifications our billing team needs so we can produce a definitive recommendation: 

Operational asks for AP/billing: 
- If PO path: confirm the PO number format (numeric or alphanumeric) and whether we should place PO at invoice-level only or both header + line item.
- If marketplace path (AWS Marketplace): does your finance team require a consolidated monthly invoice from marketplace or individual invoices per vendor?
- Tax/VAT: please confirm billing tax ID and whether you require Redwood to include tax breakdown line items.
- Remit-to address: for PO invoices, our default is: Redwood Inference, 220 Montgomery St, San Francisco, CA 94104. If Astra needs a different remit-to block on the invoice for internal routing, let us know.

I attached a sample Redwood invoice that shows the fields we typically include; if you want any additional custom fields we can add them for PO-generated invoices. Also happy to provide a formal SOW template if procurement requires project-level line items.

Would you be available for a 20-min call Wednesday to confirm the billing fields so we can finalize the pilot paperwork?

Thanks,
Jasmine

Attachments: redwood_invoice_sample.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Andrew Park <andrew.park@astrahealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@astrahealth.com>, Astra Health Procurement <procurement@astrahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Payment path & invoice format questions (PO / Marketplace / Net terms)

Hi Jasmine, Sophie —

Thanks for the attachments and clarity. Quick answers from procurement after an internal check: 

- PO format: Alphanumeric PO numbers are fine (e.g., AST-2026-501). Please include PO both in the invoice header and the line item reference.
- Marketplace: We prefer marketplace billing when possible for vendor consolidation, but for this pilot we’d prefer a direct PO to Redwood to keep project accounting simple. If the pilot expands we will evaluate moving to AWS Marketplace.
- Tax: Include our EIN: 12-3456789 and show tax as a separate line item.
- Remit-to: Please use the Redwood remit-to in the sample invoice — internal routing will accept that for now.
- Net terms: Net 30 on PO invoices.

I’m available Wed 5pm PT for a short call if you want to confirm any final fields. Otherwise we’ll issue a PO once we have a short SOW and final invoice sample with the PO placement included.

Andrew Park
Senior Procurement Manager | Astra Health
procurement@astrahealth.com
